steps.name: Copy API key
steps.why: the reveal modal shows exactly one copy control, so the accessible name is unambiguous here -- unlike nous-research, where every row has an identical icon button

notes: Already authenticated via the robot profile (Kunal Das) -- no Google step is in the recording. The site is behind a 'Vercel Security Checkpoint' that clears ITSELF after roughly 10 seconds with no interaction and nothing solved; replay's resolve_wait (18s) absorbs that, so no special step is needed. Create is a two-step modal: 'Create API Key' -> name input -> 'Create Key' -> a reveal modal with 'Copy API key' and 'Done'. Only ONE model exists: mercury-2, a diffusion model that spends REASONING tokens before emitting content -- a 16-token budget returns HTTP 200 with content "", which is why the probe budget was raised to 128. PROVEN 2026-08-23 upstream (GET api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1/models -> 200, 1 model; POST /v1/chat/completions on mercury-2 -> 200 with the real word 'Paris') AND through OmniRoute (inception/mercury-2 -> real streamed text). The account already held 4 keys from earlier attempts, so revoking the spares is a cleanup item for the operator.
